items.title: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI
items.summary: College Planner is coming to ChatGPT for Teens to help students manage college applications, alongside new flashcards, quizzes, and a teen AI council.

items.title: Radisson Hotel Group brings hotel discovery into ChatGPT
items.summary: Radisson partnered with Accenture to build a ChatGPT plugin using OpenAI technology, helping travelers find, compare, and book hotels while planning their trips.
